source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Verify test results with accredited laboratories.
3. Report findings as a public health advisory.
4. Issue a boil water notice, if necessary.
5. Publish transparent, detailed reports.
6. Include information on contaminants detected and at what levels.
7. Explain potential health risks associated with the contaminants.
8. Provide instructions on how to protect oneself against these risks.
9. Update ongoing results and actions.
10. Follow up with remediation measures and timelines.
11. Ensure continuous communication with the public.
12. Provide contact information for further inquiries and assistance.
13. Work with local health departments to confirm and amplify information.
14. Use multiple platforms (e.g., social media, websites, local newspapers) to spread the message.
15. Issue alerts through SMS systems to registered residents.
16. Regularly update the status of the water quality and remediation progress.
17. Cooperate with environmental agencies for comprehensive analysis.
18. Conduct frequent tests to ensure continued
